name: Fenix
verdict: Fenix is an interior-materials brand of the Italian manufacturer Arpa Industriale, part of Broadview Holding and controlled by HAL Holding N.V. (listed in Amsterdam via HAL Trust). Nothing found.
note: The FENIX interior-materials brand of Arpa Industriale (Bra, Italy); namesake of the women's team Fenix-Premier Tech and on the lower back of the 2026 Alpecin-Premier Tech jersey. Rating note: brand link confirmed via fenixforinteriors.com (claim fenix-arpa-ownership); Arpa Industriale is part of Broadview Holding, controlled by HAL Holding N.V., Amsterdam-listed via HAL Trust (claim arpa-broadview-hal-ownership); no state or state fund in the chain, no relevant record found. Open question kept from previous research: a 'Fenix 2025' apparel partner of golf's International Series (deal international-series-fenix) may be a different brand, and the deal record may need splitting.
